title: Sister Maria's flame in the convent cell

tellings.quote: in the late 1800s while sleeping in her small cell in a Catholic Convent a young nun named sister Maria was awakened by a shining object like a flame that appeared to emerge from her room's wall and hover above her

plain: A young nun named Sister Maria was sleeping in her small cell in a Catholic convent when she woke up to see a shining object, like a flame, come out of the wall and hover above her. Michels tells it in an episode about UFOs and religion and puts it in the late 1800s, while the story itself is dated 1807 to 1809. He tells it to show that encounters like this have long been part of religious experience.
